policies.title: Barbadian ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea short-visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Barbados's current Foreign Affairs outbound schedule expressly records no visa requirement for Equatorial Guinea and says the waiver agreement covers all passport categories.
conditions: Applies to a Barbadian ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor; the schedule's waiver remark covers all passport categories.

The live Barbados Foreign Affairs page currently links the country schedule. It gives no nationality-wide short-stay duration, work, residence, transit or admission terms for this row; none is inferred.
Border, health, carrier and final-admission requirements remain separate from the visa waiver.

unresolved.reason: No current Tunisian or Equatorial Guinean primary source directly maps an ordinary Tunisian passport to a waiver, required visa or a specific issuance route. The live eVisa service says all nationalities may apply, but does not identify who needs a visa or disprove a bilateral waiver; its decision text also refers to seeking a visa-on-arrival stamp. Portal availability and a possible alternative route are not used to override the fallback visa_free status.
